self_assessment.weakest_area: Homepage popular cards now show a 16px owner avatar only when skill.official is true (preserves original conditional). Without verifying in browser, unclear whether the visual rhythm reads as the contract intended for non-official popular skills.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Bound :show-owner-avatar="skill.official" on the homepage instead of unconditional show-owner-avatar from the contract literal — the literal would render avatars on every popular card, breaking the existing official-only marker.

known_limitations: C14 is partial: skills/index.vue still has copyCmd/copiedName/useClipboard for the npm Algolia search results section (lines 145-155, 375-410). The contract author treated this section as out of scope by omission (only listed registry skill cards in the replacement table); cleaning it up requires a separate component or refactor that isn't covered by the SkillCard abstraction (npm packages aren't RegistrySkill).

Behavior change: /skills (official + community) and /nuxt now lead with description/signal-chip rather than install command in the card body. This is the intended rollout per contract Risk 1 but worth a visual sanity check in the browser.

Contract C6 says clipboard receives `npx -y skilld add gh:{owner}/{repo}/{name}`. Actual gitInstallCmd helper produces `npx -y skilld add gh:{owner}/{repo} -s {name}` (the existing convention). The component matches the existing helper, not the C6 string.
next_steps: Run /nuxt-frontend-review skill-card-component-0427-0942 to verify visual diff on /orgs/github, the new description-led look on /skills + /nuxt, and that the homepage popular grid renders as expected with conditional avatars.
Future cleanup: factor an NpmPackageCard for the Algolia search results, then drop copyCmd/copiedName from skills/index.vue.
